config.arm: ARM Y: random-init + KITTI only, 200 epochs, downsample_levels=3 + num_disparities=24 (stride 1/8, 8px spacing, range 184px) + cost_volume_shift=right + regression_normalize=True + left-image-guided cost-volume excitation
config.intervention: left-image-guided cost-volume excitation: Conv2d(32,16,1,bias=False) -> LeakyReLU(0.01) -> Conv2d(16,32,1) -> sigmoid, broadcast over D, applied between cost volume and aggregation
config.split_enforcement: train_base split='hailo_calib' only; no hailo_val sample enters optimizer loop
config.loss: masked smooth L1, beta=1.0, valid = gt > 0 and gt < max_disparity
config.augmentation: random crop, independent per-image gain jitter sigma=0.1; no horizontal flip
config.known_deviation: no batch normalisation (BN-folded exported artifact), carried into all arms
